title: Large-parameter negativity
statement: Let $C,\delta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1\le C$, $0<\delta$, and $1/(10C)<\delta$. Then $1-\delta/2-2\eta(C,\delta)<0$, where $\eta(C,\delta)=16C^2\delta^2\max\{\log_2(1/(C\delta)),1\}$.
